name: wmc
description: WMC — World Muslim Community. Find your people, wherever you are.

scripts.db:bundle: bash -c 'cd supabase && { echo "-- ============================================================================="; echo "-- WMC — combined schema for the Supabase SQL Editor (generated from migrations/)"; echo "-- Paste the whole file into Dashboard → SQL Editor → Run, on a fresh project."; echo "-- Regenerate: npm run db:bundle"; echo "-- ============================================================================="; for f in migrations/*.sql; do echo; echo "-- >>> $f"; cat "$f"; done; } > schema.sql'
